title: Raw over comparison component
statement: For a commutative ring Λ, schemes W and S, k:W→S, a sheaf G on W_et,  an integer q, an arrow f:A→B of objects over W, an etale S-object U, and a raw class z on B, the explicitly constructed raw pullback r_f(z) satisfies e_A(r_f(z)) = t_f(e_B(z)), where e_A and e_B are the fixed raw comparison maps to the associated higher direct image sections and t_f is the canonical higher-image transition. This is the evaluated section equality used by the naturality theorem.

source.place: Tags 03Q8 and 09Z1, canonical comparison maps; explicit derived-Hom formulation

proof.text: Expand ToHom as derived adjunction, zero-degree homology, and homology shift comparison. Expand the transition as unit, pullback composition and counit. Naturality of the unit and the triangle identity identify its adjunct with pullback of the class. The single-complex composition comparison gives the first two raw factors. Compatibility with shifts of these canonical derived adjunctions and composition maps gives the shift factor and identifies zero-degree shifted homology with degree-q homology. Naturality in the specified coefficient morphism v gives the final factor and H^q(Rh′_*v).

lean.statement:
theorem higherDirectImageRawOverPullback_comparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    {A B : Over W} (f : A ⟶ B) (U : S.Etale)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q B).obj (op U)) :
    (higherDirectImageRawOverComparison Λ k G q A).app (op U)
        (higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U z) =
    ((higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q f).hom.app (op U))
      ((higherDirectImageRawOverComparison Λ k G q B).app (op U) z)
